reuse.why: Reuses assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but the link and download flows are pasted from the Akahu functions instead of being shared.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount (about 70 lines) and downloadFintegraTransactions a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, adding a sixth copy of each pattern.

placement.why: Handler, download function, sync dispatch, server URL and type all sit where the tree puts per-provider code.

scope.why: Only Fintegra server support plus a release note.

maintainability.why: Follows the established pattern but grows the per-provider copies, so every future change to linking or downloading has another place to update.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared link or download function exists in the tree to bypass; the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked helper is used.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of linkAkahuAccount and downloadAkahuTransactions are verbatim apart from provider names, not disguised.
